consent.title: Before we start
consent.camera: Allow SMARAN to use the camera sometimes, to understand how games make you feel?
consent.mic: Allow SMARAN to use the microphone sometimes, for the same reason?
consent.dataSharing: Share your game results with your family so they can see how you're doing?
consent.needOnline: We will save this when you are connected. Camera and microphone stay off until then.
consent.disclaimer: SMARAN is a support tool to help with memory games. It is not a medical diagnosis.
